content: Matplotlib 3.11.1 (July 2026). For reproducible SVG: set mpl.rcParams svg.hashsalt to a fixed string like fdars-docs so clip-path IDs become deterministic across builds. Set numpy random seed before any stochastic data generation. The pyfda docs_fig.py already has a solid rcParams dict. Matplotlib backend must be Agg for headless build (already set). Style files can be loaded with plt.style.use(path). savefig params: format=svg, bbox_inches=tight, transparent=True (already in rcParams).
